title: Virginia Discovery Museum

services.name: Exhibits
services.desc: The Virginia Discovery Museum follows a free-flowing, single-floor layout comprised of two main galleries and maintains several hands-on educational play areas over 6,000 square feet of exhibit space. There is no preset route to follow, so families are invited to explore our exhibits at their own pace and in any order they choose. Each area is designed to engage children cognitively, physically, and socially, and our staff seeks to foster an environment in which children learn through exploratory and imaginative play and collaborative problem-solving. - New Year’s Day - Memorial Day - Juneteenth - Independence Day - Labor Day - Thanksgiving Day - Christmas Eve - Christmas Day The Virginia

services.name: Toddler Yoga & Movement
services.desc: explores and encourages physical wellness and emotional regulation in early childhood development through mindfulness, stretching, games, and play. This program is led by Programs & Administrative Coordinator Emily Pearcy, a certified 95-hour registered children’s yoga teacher. She has 4 years of experience teaching children ranging from infancy to age 13 and received her certification through Kidding Around Yoga, a Yoga Alliance recognized program. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Camps at the Virginia Discovery Museum embody all that summer should be: exploration and fun! Whether your child is brand new to the camp experience or already knows the ropes, our week-long, half-day summer camps for children 4 to 8 provide opportunities for kids to gain confidence, make friends, and explore a range of enrichment-focused topics through creative, engaging, and hands-on learning and play experiences. Plus, campers enjoy a special playtime in the galleries each morning before the Museum opens to the public. Ages 4-8: Blast off on an out-of-this-world expedition! Soar across the galaxy exploring planets, stars, and cosmic environments as we learn what makes space so mysterious

services.name: party rentals
services.desc: Forget the stress and mess … birthday parties, small-group playdates, and private events at the Virginia Discovery Museum are as easy as 1-2-3! The Museum's open galleries, bright colors, and interactive exhibits provide a safe and playful atmosphere for any occasion, and our great location on Charlottesville's Downtown Mall is within walking distance of convenient parking, delivery and catering services, coffee shops and restaurants, and local shopping. With semi-private Saturday and fully private Sunday time slots available, discover why VDM is your perfect party spot! All party and event rentals must be booked at least 2 weeks in advance, and a $75 deposit is required to reserve a date

services.name: Showalter Cabin
services.desc: Travel back in time to the 1700s as you step inside VDM’s historic log cabin. Originally built in Rockingham County, Va., by the Showalter family, a section of the cabin was relocated to Charlottesville and installed in the Museum’s front gallery when VDM first opened its doors on the Downtown Mall in 1990. Dress up in period costumes, tend to the chickens in the coop next to the front porch, gather the eggs, keep an eye out for the sly fox, and prepare a meal over the fireplace, as you engage in imaginative play and discover how life was different in Virginia hundreds of years ago. services.name: Date Night Drop-Off
services.desc: Parents, need a Friday night out? Let the Virginia Discovery Museum watch the kids on select Friday evenings while you enjoy some much-deserved time to yourselves! Children will enjoy hands-on crafts, games, activities, and plenty of playtime in our exhibit galleries, all while interacting with other kids in a safe setting. Due to food allergy concerns, VDM does not provide dinner or snacks itself during Date Night Drop-Off, but the program does include a break for dinner. Participants must pack a nut-free, ready-to-eat bagged meal and labeled water bottle. Program: $35/Child. Child Must Pack a Nut-Free, Ready-to-Eat Bagged Meal. Annual Members: 10% Off. services.name: JMRL Pass Program
services.desc: The JMRL Pass Program is a collaboration between the Jefferson-Madison Regional Library and the Virginia Discovery Museum. This local program allows JMRL cardholders to check out a Museum pass from any of the library’s branches with their library card. A limited number of passes are available on a first-come, first-served basis at each branch, and each pass grants free general admission to the Museum for up to 4 people during a 1-week loan period.* Passes may be used multiple times during the loan period, but they cannot be immediately renewed.
